p1_body: Paint protection film (PPF) and window film protect your car's surface with a clear layer.
p2_body: The film is applied only by authorized Olexfilms dealers. Every job starts with a measurement and is tailored to your car.
p3_body: Your digital warranty is a record tied to your car, the parts applied and its term. Verify it by QR; it transfers when you sell the car and stays on your phone even if the paper card is lost.
